title: Data and code for: Exact window re-optimization of Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search tours for the Covering Tour Problem
description: 590 audited runs (59 instances x 10 seeds) of an ALNS for the Covering Tour Problem followed by a Micro-MIP window polisher, with the ALNS logs, protocol, polisher, auditing code and scripts that generate the tables and figures of the paper. Code is MIT-licensed; data are CC BY 4.0.
